'''Duelmania DownUnder 2019''' is the first installment of the Australian heavy Duelmania edition. 

With 22 entries confirmed in Australia, the Duelmania DownUnder 2019 bracket was released the 10th September. The first game was played the day after, between {{player|dEF|flag=au}} vs {{player|Hodgzilla |flag=au|link=false}}.

{{player|dirtbox|flag=au}} created a [http://cooked.live/videos/quakeworld/25/cooked-academy-getting-started-with-quakeworld quick start video] for new players from Quake Live and Quake Champions to get up and running easily in Quakeworld.

===Format===
* Double Elimination Bracket
* No division or groups
* All games {{abbr|BO5|Best of five}}
